SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

EIP712DomainChanged().details: MAY be emitted to signal that the domain could have changed.

attestationDigest((bytes32,uint256,bytes.details: Public so an off-chain party — the attester, a test, a reader — can ask the consumer what it will check rather than reimplementing the domain. Equal to `oracleAttestationDigest` in the protocol package for the same consumer and message.

eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

unlockCallback(bytes).details: One gate swap: an exact-input sale of a plea (IMD to the seller), or an exact-output fee swap (IMD to the Letterbox, PLEA in capped). Either way the gate pays the PLEA it holds.

DEFINITIONS.details: The `definitions` object's members, JSON-ready (each value at most 512 characters). Rules v3 (calibrated on Sepolia 2026-10-12): plea scoring, stories, content, manipulation, answer.

devdoc.title: CabalGate — the only way to sell PLEA while the Cabal lives

PleaFailed(uint256,uint8,bytes32,uint16,.notice: The Intake reported no verdict for the plea (status 1 refused, 2 no answer). The reason and counts are the Intake writer's word (unsigned); the plea was only cleared.

PleaFlags(uint256,uint8).notice: The plea came through the Letterbox: by letter (bit 1) and/or selling itself (bit 2).

MIN_SHARE_BPS().notice: A plea is at least 1% of the seller's PLEA, so points always put real PLEA on the line.

SEASON().notice: Season length (read by Seasons) and the dead-man. Deploy-time so Sepolia can run a fast clock; on chain id 1 `PleaLaunch.seed` refuses anything below 15 days and 33 hours (checked at seed, on the live chain: launch rehearsals deploy the manifest on a bare EVM with chain id 1, where a constructor check would refuse Sepolia's settings).

appeal(uint256,uint256,string).notice: Appeal a denied plea once, within 4 hours of the denial, for an amount no larger than the original: 0.5 oracle IMD plus 0.35 pool IMD to the buy wall. An unanswered, expired appeal may be retried within that same window, paying the fees again.

appealFor(address,uint256,uint256,uint25.notice: The Letterbox appeals `originalId` for its seller, for at most the original amount; the fees (oracle, wall share) come from the seller's PLEA as in `submitFor`.

attestationDigest((bytes32,uint256,bytes.notice: The digest the oracle signed: this consumer's domain over the attestation.

begin().notice: Starts the Cabal when trading opens (PleaLaunch.seed).

body(uint256).notice: The oracle body paid to the Intake, compact JSON (`oracle.request@oracle-1`).

cabalAlive().notice: The Cabal lives from the start until `DEADMAN` passes without a signed score. Once dead it stays dead: a verdict needs a living Cabal, so nothing can reset the clock.

consumed(bytes32).notice: Request ids this consumer has acted on, for consumers that call `_consume`.

diedAt().notice: When the Cabal died; zero while it lives or before trading opens.

executeSell(uint256).notice: Executes the caller's approved sell within the 7-minute window: the whole amount in one swap, for at least `minOut` IMD. Pleas escrowed by the Letterbox sell through it instead.

executeSellFor(uint256,uint256).notice: The Letterbox sells an approved plea it escrowed, from its own PLEA, for the seller: the IMD goes to the Letterbox, which pays the seller (less its auto-sell fee).

expire(uint256).notice: Anyone may clear a pending plea that can no longer get a verdict: 20 minutes passed, or the Intake completed the request without one (the panel disagreed or refused).

factScore(address,uint256).notice: The on-chain fact score (0-41) for `seller` selling `amount` now: share of the balance at most 20%: 16, at most 35%: 9, more: 3; held 7 days: 3, 3 days: 2, 1 day: 1; at a loss: 13, gain at most 50%: 12, 200%: 10, 500%: 8, 1,000%: 6, more: 4 (PLEA no buy record covers: held since trading opened, profit 9); 24h trend up: 9, flat: 5, down: 0. Prices are the hook's hourly checkpoints, never the spot price, and the holding time is buy-weighted.

imd().notice: The pool's IMD (Sepolia: TestIMD 0x2b69…), used for the appeal's pool share.

lastPleaOf(address).notice: Each seller's newest plea or appeal (what a letter's APPEAL refers to).

onOracleResult(bytes32,(bytes32,uint256,.notice: The Intake's callback (selector 0x510379c7, 200k gas): stores the signed score and the verdict, nothing else. Points are recorded later by Seasons.

onPleaFailure(bytes32,uint8,bytes32,uint.notice: The Intake's failure function (status 1 refused, 2 no answer). Failures are unsigned, so this only clears the plea it was asked for while it is still pending, exactly as `expire` would: no cooldown, no verdict, no clock reset, no value moved. `expire` stays as the fallback.

oracleAsset().notice: What the Intake is paid in (Sepolia: test IMD 0x44a1…; mainnet: IMD).

oracleSigner().notice: The address every attestation must verify against: a key, or a registry of keys.

pleaBalance(uint256).notice: The pre-escrow balance a plea was validated and scored against. An appeal's minimum cannot grow beyond the original basis when its seller acquires more PLEA after the denial, and the Letterbox keeps an appeal's share of the balance at most the original's.

question(uint256).notice: The question the judges read for plea `id` (plain text; `body` sends it JSON-escaped).

restricted().notice: Sell limits apply before trading opens and while the Cabal lives.

result(uint256).notice: What Seasons reads: whether the plea's verdict was an approval, and its score.

startedAt().notice: When trading opened and the Cabal began (zero before).

submitFor(address,uint256,uint256,string.notice: The Letterbox pleads for `seller` (who sent the letter or the site's auto-sell plea in this very transaction): same rules as `submitSell`, scored on `balance`, the seller's PLEA before the Letterbox escrowed the plea. The fees come from the seller's PLEA: the gate sells at most `maxFeePlea` of the Letterbox's PLEA for exactly `feeImd` IMD (to the Letterbox), then the Letterbox pays the oracle fee.

submitSell(uint256,string).notice: Plead to sell `amount` PLEA. Pays 0.5 oracle IMD to the Intake.

userdoc.notice: A seller submits a plea and pays the IdentityMD Intake for an oracle question; a panel of 30 judges ("the Cabal") scores the plea 0-45 and the signed score comes back through the Intake's callback. A score at or above the seller's need (69 minus the on-chain fact score) opens a seven-minute window to sell through this gate. The Cabal lives from the moment trading opens until `DEADMAN` passes without a signed score. Then it is dead for good and PLEA trades freely forever. "Alive" is computed, never stored, so nobody has to call anything when it dies.
